If a defect is reported by the Client, the Supplier shall commence a root‑cause investigation within two (2) business days and shall remediate the defect to the Client’s reasonable satisfaction no later than ten (10) business days thereafter. The Supplier shall provide written status updates at least every three (3) business days until resolution.

The Supplier shall indemnify, defend and hold harmless the Manufacturer, its affiliates and officers from any claim, loss, or damage arising out of the acts or omissions of any Subcontractor or third‑party vendor engaged by the Supplier in connection with the manufacturing process.

{"clause_type": "indemnification", "risk_level": "high", "key_obligations": ["indemnify manufacturer", "defend claims", "cover damages"], "summary": "Supplier must protect the Manufacturer against liabilities caused by Subcontractors or vendors."}

Extract metadata from this clause:

If a force majeure event disrupts the Supplier’s manufacturing facilities, the Supplier shall, within ten (10) business days, furnish a detailed mitigation plan outlining alternative production arrangements, including the use of third‑party manufacturers. The Buyer may, at its discretion, approve any such arrangement or suspend orders until the Supplier demonstrates restored capacity. All costs incurred in implementing the mitigation plan shall be borne by the Supplier.

{"clause_type": "force_majeure", "risk_level": "medium", "key_obligations": ["submit mitigation plan", "seek buyer approval"], "summary": "Requires supplier to propose alternative production and bear associated costs."}

Extract metadata from this clause:

Except for liability arising from a breach of the indemnification obligations set forth in Section 8, each party’s total cumulative liability to the other for any and all claims shall not exceed the greater of (i) the total fees paid by the Client to the Provider during the twelve (12) months preceding the incident, or (ii) USD 1,000,000. This limitation applies to all causes of action, whether in contract, tort, or otherwise.

{"clause_type": "limitation_of_liability", "risk_level": "medium", "key_obligations": ["cap liability", "exclude indemnity breaches"], "summary": "Liability is capped at the higher of recent fees or one million dollars, except for indemnification breaches."}

The Carrier shall maintain cargo insurance covering full replacement value and a business interruption endorsement sufficient to cover loss of revenue arising from Force Majeure events. Certificates of such coverage shall be delivered to the Shipper within ten (10) days of contract execution and upon any renewal. The Carrier shall promptly notify the Shipper of any material change or lapse in coverage.

{"clause_type": "insurance", "risk_level": "low", "key_obligations": ["Maintain cargo insurance", "Include business interruption coverage", "Provide certificates"], "summary": "Requires insurance to protect against losses from force majeure disruptions."}

The Provider warrants that the Work Product, as delivered, does not infringe any third‑party intellectual property rights. If a claim of infringement arises, the Provider shall, at its own expense, defend, indemnify, and, if necessary, replace or modify the infringing portion of the Work Product. This warranty is limited to the duration of the Services and does not cover modifications made by the Customer.

{"clause_type": "warranty", "risk_level": "high", "key_obligations": ["warrant non‑infringement", "defend claims", "replace infringing parts"], "summary": "Provider warrants non‑infringement and will remediate any infringement claims."}

In no event shall the Operator's total liability for loss of profit, loss of revenue, or any other special damages exceed the aggregate fees paid under this agreement during the twelve months preceding the claim. The parties acknowledge that this cap reflects a reasonable allocation of risk given the project's scale.

Extract metadata from this clause:

Either Party may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon thirty (30) days written notice to the other Party. Upon such termination, the Service Provider shall invoice for all Services performed up to the effective termination date and the Client shall pay all undisputed amounts within fifteen (15) business days. The terminating Party shall not be liable for any further damages or penalties beyond the payment of accrued fees.

{"clause_type": "termination", "risk_level": "low", "key_obligations": ["provide notice", "invoice for services", "pay undisputed amounts"], "summary": "Allows either side to end the contract without cause with notice, requiring payment for services rendered up to termination."}

The Contractor warrants only the materials supplied by it, and such warranty shall commence upon delivery and continue for six (6) months. The Contractor shall retain all relevant material test reports for the duration of the warranty period. The Owner is responsible for notifying the Contractor of any material failure within fifteen (15) days of detection.

Each automatic renewal is conditioned on the Provider maintaining the Service Level Agreements set forth in Exhibit A; failure to meet those SLA thresholds for two consecutive months gives the Customer the right to terminate the Agreement prior to the renewal date. In the event of such termination, the renewal shall be deemed void and the Parties shall revert to the terms of the preceding term.

{"clause_type": "renewal", "risk_level": "medium", "key_obligations": ["maintain SLA", "exercise termination right"], "summary": "Renewal depends on meeting SLA targets, and persistent failures allow the customer to cancel before renewal."}

The Provider shall identify all such components in an annex and ensure that the Customer’s use complies with the applicable open‑source terms. The Supplier shall maintain a monthly service availability of at least 99.5% for all hosted manufacturing execution systems, measured against the Supplier’s monitoring tools. If the monthly availability falls below this threshold, the Supplier shall issue service credits equal to 5% of the affected month’s fees for each 0.1% shortfall, up to a maximum of 25% of that month’s invoice. Performance reports will be delivered to the Customer within five business days after month‑end.

{"clause_type": "sla", "risk_level": "medium", "key_obligations": ["maintain 99.5% uptime", "provide monthly performance reports", "apply service credits"], "summary": "The provider must achieve 99.5% monthly availability and credit the customer for any shortfall, with reporting requirements."}

The Distributor shall be the sole source for non‑emergency supplies of the Drug X to the Clinic, but may fulfill emergency orders for other hospitals when required by law. For all non‑emergency sales, the Distributor must provide the Clinic with a most‑favored‑nation price, matching any lower price given to any other buyer.

{"clause_type": "exclusivity", "risk_level": "low", "key_obligations": ["restrict non‑emergency sales", "provide MFN price", "allow emergency exceptions"], "summary": "The distributor exclusively serves the clinic for routine supplies and must match any lower price offered to other buyers, while emergency sales remain unrestricted."}

The Supplier shall sell the Provider all pharmaceutical products listed in Schedule A on an exclusive basis throughout the Territory. In addition, the Supplier agrees to extend to the Provider the most‑favored‑nation price, meaning any lower price offered to any third party for the same products shall be applied to the Provider within ten business days of such offer.

The Carrier shall maintain a Business Continuity Plan that guarantees a minimum of ninety‑nine percent (99%) on‑time delivery across its network. If a disruption occurs, the Carrier must immediately activate alternative routing, notify the Shipper of the revised ETA, and submit a post‑incident report within five (5) business days. Failure to meet these standards will constitute a Service Level breach.

{"clause_type": "sla", "risk_level": "medium", "key_obligations": ["Maintain 99% on‑time delivery", "Report disruptions", "Implement backup routes"], "summary": "Sets performance metrics and contingency actions for logistics continuity."}
